title: Walk-and-Talk Review
description: The team walks a slow lap of the court while the coach reviews the day's key points, combining a physical cooldown with a mental recap.

content.objective: Lower the heart rate gradually while reinforcing the day's main lessons verbally.
content.setup: The team walks together in a loose group around the perimeter of the court.
instructions: Walk at an easy pace as a group for one full lap of the court.
The coach reviews two or three key points from the day's practice.
Players are encouraged to ask questions or share what they noticed.
Finish the lap and gather for a short closing message.
coachingPoints: Keep the pace genuinely easy — this is recovery, not more conditioning.
Keep the review focused on two or three points, not an exhaustive list.
Encourage real participation rather than a one-way lecture.
commonMistakes: Walking so fast it stops being a true cooldown.
Covering too many points, losing the players' attention.
Treating it as optional instead of part of the session.
content.safety: Make sure the walking path is clear of any remaining equipment.
